title: Audit trail entry is created when the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' setting is changed
preconditions: Logged-in user has Admin or Onboarding Admin role with access to Onboarding Settings
Enable BGV toggle is ON in Advanced Settings > BGV Settings
Audit trail is accessible to the test Admin user

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Flows > Onboarding > Advanced Settings.
In the BGV Settings section, check the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' checkbox (if not already checked). Set the numeric input value to 30.
steps.expected: Checkbox is checked and numeric input shows 30.
Settings saved successfully with a success notification.

steps.action: Navigate to the platform audit trail for Onboarding Settings (accessible via the audit trail link on the Advanced Settings page or via the platform audit log).
steps.expected: The audit trail page loads and shows recent activity.

steps.action: Locate the most recent audit entry for the Onboarding Settings / Advanced Settings change just performed. Inspect the entry details.
steps.expected: An audit trail entry exists recording the change to 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion'. The entry includes: the actor (Admin user who made the change), the timestamp of the change, the old value (checkbox unchecked / prior day value), and the new value (checkbox checked, days = 30).

steps.action: Return to Settings > Flows > Onboarding > Advanced Settings. Uncheck the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' checkbox and click Save.
Return to the audit trail and locate the new entry for this second change.
steps.expected: A new audit trail entry exists recording the checkbox being unchecked, with the correct actor, timestamp, old value (checked, 30 days), and new value (unchecked).

expected_result: Every save of the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' field group generates a corresponding audit trail entry capturing the actor, timestamp, and before/after values.
assertions_summary: Audit entry created on checkbox enable with day value
Audit entry captures actor identity and timestamp
Audit entry captures old and new values
Audit entry created on checkbox disable
